description: Unit tests for the AudioRenderer component in the starboard media framework, testing various playback scenarios including normal operation, seeking, and EOS handling.

classes.name: AudioRendererTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing the AudioRenderer component, including setup, helper functions, and test cases.

methods.name: ResetToFormat
methods.description: Configures the test fixture with specified audio sample type and storage type, initializing mocks and the renderer.

methods.name: FillRendererWithDecodedAudioAndWriteEOS
methods.description: Feeds decoded audio data into the renderer until it reaches its preroll threshold, then writes an End Of Stream.

methods.name: WriteSample
methods.description: Decodes and writes a sample buffer into the renderer.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the renderer.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Performs a seek operation on the renderer to a specified timestamp.

methods.name: CallConsumedCB
methods.description: Invokes the consumed callback to simulate decoder consumption.

methods.name: SendDecoderOutput
methods.description: Provides decoded audio data to the renderer via the output callback.

methods.name: CreateInputBuffer
methods.description: Creates an input buffer with specified timestamp.

methods.name: CreateDecodedAudio
methods.description: Creates a decoded audio object with specified timestamp and frame count.

methods.name: OnPrerolled
methods.description: Callback indicating the renderer has reached preroll.
